An "official announcement" means a statement by the person themselves, their authorized representative, or the official body governing the office that the person will be departing from the office. Such announcements must be reported by at least one Source Agency to be considered official. Temporary absences such as medical leave, suspension with possibility of return, or delegation of duties while retaining the office do NOT constitute leaving office. Death does NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion for this Contract. Forced departures (termination, impeachment and removal, etc.) satisfy the Payout Criterion even without a prior announcement.

“Dropped out” means any of the following:
Max Miller announces they are ending, suspending, or withdrawing from their campaign
Max Miller files official withdrawal paperwork with relevant election authorities
Max Miller publicly states they are no longer seeking the office
Max Miller endorses another candidate while stating they are no longer running
Max Miller is disqualified by election authorities or courts and does not appeal

The following do NOT constitute dropping out:
Losing a primary or election
Failing to qualify for debates or ballots
Temporarily suspending campaign activities without withdrawing
Being eliminated through the normal election process
Reducing campaign activities while remaining a candidate

Once someone drops out per above criteria, the market resolves YES even if they later re-enter
“Suspending” a campaign is treated as dropping out unless Max Miller explicitly states they remain a candidate
For primary races, dropping out of the presidential race entirely counts as dropping out of that party’s primary
Withdrawing from the race counts even if the person remains on the ballot

KXPIRROOUT.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the specific individual leaves the role as defined in the payout criteria.
KXPIRROOUT.rules_primary: If Jeanine Pirro leaves as United States Attorney for the District of Columbia before Aug 7, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXPIRROOUT.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on when the departure is publicly announced or officially communicated, regardless of the effective date.

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role—this includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.
KXPIRROOUT.title: Will Jeanine Pirro announce their departure as United States Attorney for the District of Columbia before Aug 7, 2026?

KXZELENSKYYOUT.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the person announces departure or actually leaves office.
KXZELENSKYYOUT.rules_primary: If Volodymyr Zelenskyy has either officially announced their intention to leave as President of Ukraine or has actually left as President of Ukraine before Jul 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXZELENSKYYOUT.rules_secondary:
An "official announcement" means a statement by the person themselves, their authorized representative, or the official body governing the office that the person will be departing from the office. Such announcements must be reported by at least one Source Agency to be considered official. The announcement must not specify they are leaving in more than a year from the statement, in which case the market does not resolve to Yes.

"Leaving office" means the person no longer holds the office in any capacity, including but not limited to: resignation (effective), termination, removal, impeachment and removal, recall, or the expiration of their term without renewal. Temporary absences such as medical leave, suspension with possibility of return, or delegation of duties while retaining the office do NOT constitute leaving office. Death does NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion for this Contract. Forced departures (termination, impeachment and removal, etc.) satisfy the Payout Criterion even without a prior announcement.
KXZELENSKYYOUT.title: Will Volodymyr Zelenskyy leave President of Ukraine before Jul 1, 2026?

This market resolves based on when the departure is publicly announced or officially communicated, regardless of the effective date.

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role—this includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.

This includes:
Roll call votes
Recorded votes
Yea-and-nay votes
Electronic votes (in the House)
Division/standing votes

Voice votes where individual member positions are not recorded

Procedural determinations by the presiding officer
Deemed passage without an actual vote

A vote on the rule governing debate of the bill/motion DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion if the bill/motion specifically refers to that rule
A vote on a motion to proceed to the bill/motion DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion
A vote on final passage DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion
A vote on an amendment to the bill/motion does NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion unless the bill/motion specifically refers to that amendment

KXCANUSDEAL.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
KXCANUSDEAL.rules_primary: If Canada and the United States have concluded a final trade agreement after Issuance and before Aug 24, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXCANUSDEAL.rules_secondary:
An agreement is concluded if either:

it is signed or formally executed by authorized officials of both governments, or
both governments announce that negotiations have concluded and that the agreed tariff changes are being implemented, or those tariff changes take legal effect in both countries under the agreement.

An agreement can be concluded even if individual sectors remain subject to further negotiation, and regardless of when the agreed changes take effect.

The following do NOT count:

Anything announced before Issuance, including the announcements of August 18 and 19, 2026 of a deal reached, agreed in principle, or pending final documentation, and any draft agreement reported before Issuance

custom_strike.Topic: Fort Wayne, Indiana ends its use of Flock Safety license plate reader cameras

KXFLOCKDROPPED.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
KXFLOCKDROPPED.rules_primary: If Fort Wayne, Indiana ends its use of Flock Safety license plate reader cameras after Issuance and before Feb 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXFLOCKDROPPED.rules_secondary:
A jurisdiction ends its use of Flock Safety cameras if its governing body, chief executive, or police department:

terminates a Flock Safety contract before the contract's scheduled end date, or
declines to renew or extend a Flock Safety contract, or declines to allow an automatic renewal to take effect, or
allows a Flock Safety contract to reach its scheduled end date without entering a renewal or replacement agreement, or
otherwise discontinues the jurisdiction's use of Flock Safety cameras, including by moving to a different license plate reader vendor.

The action must occur on or after August 21, 2026, and be reported before February 1, 2027.

The following do NOT count:

Renewing or extending the contract, even with added privacy safeguards, audit requirements or use restrictions
A temporary pause, camera deactivation, or moratorium that leaves the underlying contract in force and does not prevent its renewal
A non-binding resolution, advisory referendum or committee recommendation that the official empowered to act has not acted upon

Each jurisdiction is judged on its own, and action by a jurisdiction not named in this event does not affect any market here.

Only reporting from a Source Agency qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.
KXFLOCKDROPPED.title: Will it be reported by a Source Agency that Fort Wayne, Indiana ends its use of Flock Safety license plate reader cameras before Feb 1, 2027?

The United States sets geographic names only for its own official use, so adoption by Canada or by an international body is not required.

Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

KXMEDIARELEASESPIDERMAN.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the media is officially released.
KXMEDIARELEASESPIDERMAN.rules_primary: If the official trailer for Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse has been publicly released Worldwide through official channels before Aug 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXMEDIARELEASESPIDERMAN.rules_secondary: The media must be made available to the general public through at least one official distribution channel, including theatrical release, streaming availability, physical media (DVD, Blu-ray), or authorized digital purchase/download. The release must be accessible without special invitations or industry credentials in at least one major metropolitan area if the geography refers to a country. Private screenings, film festivals, leaked content, and torrent availability do not qualify. Trailers and soundtracks do not satisfy the criterion unless the full media is released. Different versions or formats of the same base content (theatrical, director's cut, extended edition) are considered the same media if the core content is substantially identical. Foreign language titles are considered the same media unless otherwise specified.
KXMEDIARELEASESPIDERMAN.title: Will the official trailer for Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse be released Worldwide before Aug 1, 2026?

KXROBOTAXIAREA.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
KXROBOTAXIAREA.rules_primary: If Tesla robotaxi service is offered to the general public in Florida before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXROBOTAXIAREA.rules_secondary:
For "offered to": Tesla has launched a robotaxi service in Florida that satisfies ALL of the following criteria:

The service allows members of the general public to request rides through a publicly accessible application or platform (not limited to Tesla employees, beta testers, or invite-only participants)
The vehicles operate without any human driver or safety monitor physically present in the driver's seat who is actively controlling the vehicle during normal operation
The service charges fares or fees for rides (free promotional rides alone do not qualify)

For "removed from": Tesla has discontinued, suspended, or withdrawn a previously operational robotaxi service in Florida that met all the "offered to" criteria above, where:

The service is no longer accepting new ride requests from the general public for any period of time as a result of a decision by Tesla to suspend operations in the area, and such suspension is not explicitly characterized as temporary (e.g., due to weather, maintenance, or system upgrades). The Payout Criterion is not satisfied by short-term service interruptions that are clearly communicated as temporary or expected to resume.

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:

If a government orders Tesla to cease ongoing services but they do not comply, then the market does not resolve to Yes
Services limited to Tesla employees, contractors, or their guests
Beta tests, pilot programs, or demonstrations
Services requiring special invitations, access codes, or pre-approval to use
Vehicles with human safety drivers, monitors, or operators in any seat of the vehicle who can take control
Temporary suspensions due to weather or technical issues
Services operating only with remote human teleoperators controlling each vehicle continuously
Test fleets that are not charging fares to the general public
Announcements of future launches without actual operational service
KXROBOTAXIAREA.title: Will Tesla robotaxi be offered to the general public in Florida before Jan 1, 2027?

KXTRUMPCOUNTRIES.rules_secondary:
The following do NOT constitute a visit:

Flying over the area without landing
Layovers during which the person remains in an airplane
Virtual or remote appearances
Presence in international waters adjacent to the area
Presence solely within embassy or consulate grounds
Plans, announcements, or scheduling of future visits that do not occur during the applicable time period

For the avoidance of doubt, a visit occurs only when the person exits an aircraft, vehicle, vessel, or train within the area, or otherwise physically enters the area not aboard one. Remaining aboard, including during flyovers, drive-throughs, and non-exit refueling stops, does not constitute a visit. Exiting within the area constitutes a visit regardless of duration or method of exit.
KXTRUMPCOUNTRIES.title: Will Donald Trump visit Turkey before Jan 1, 2027?

KXTRUMPENDORSELOSS.rules_primary: If the number of Trump-endorsed candidates who lose their respective primary election held after Apr 10, 2026 and before Sept 16, 2026 is exactly 9, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXTRUMPENDORSELOSS.rules_secondary:
Endorsements are determined per the specifications of the ENDORSE contract. An endorsement must be made before the primary to count; if Trump endorses multiple candidates in the same race, that race is excluded. "Primary" includes runoffs and top-two/jungle primaries (e.g., California), and any election titled a primary. A candidate who withdraws before the primary is not counted as a loss; a candidate who advances past a top-two primary and then withdraws is counted as a loss. Only primaries held after Apr 10, 2026 and before Sept 16, 2026 are included.

Clarification (06/29/26): To clarify, when a race goes to a runoff, the runoff is the operative contest, consistent with the rule that "Primary" includes runoffs. Both the South Carolina governor and Oklahoma 1st District races are excluded. In each, Trump endorsed two different candidates in the same race. In South Carolina he co-endorsed Evette and Wilson before the runoff. In Oklahoma, he endorsed Lahmeyer before the June primary and then endorsed Tedford before Tedford secured the nomination following Lahmeyer’s withdrawal. The exclusion rule applies whether the two endorsements are made together or in sequence, so both races are excluded.

KXTRUMPMOJTABA.rules_primary: If Donald Trump and Mojtaba Khamenei meet (including phone calls) before Aug 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXTRUMPMOJTABA.rules_secondary:
A meeting is defined as any of the following:

An in-person encounter where both parties are physically present in the same location
A virtual meeting via video conference where both parties can see and hear each other in real-time
A phone call where both parties speak directly to each other
Any combination of the above where the parties interact directly in real-time

The following qualify as meetings (though this list is not exhaustive):

Formal bilateral meetings, summits, or conferences
Informal encounters at multilateral events if documented by Source Agencies
Working dinners, lunches, or other meal meetings
Pull-aside meetings or corridor conversations if documented
Home visits or meetings at non-official locations

The following do NOT qualify as meetings:

Being present at the same event without direct interaction
Exchanging written correspondence
Communication through intermediaries without direct contact
Pre-recorded messages or asynchronous communication
Meetings cancelled after being scheduled
Near-misses where parties were scheduled to meet but did not
KXTRUMPMOJTABA.title: Donald Trump and Mojtaba Khamenei meet before Aug 1, 2026?

If a last traded price is not available or is not logically consistent, or if the Exchange determines at its sole discretion that the last traded prices prior to death do not represent a fair settlement value, the Outcome Review Committee will be responsible for making a binding determination of fair allocation.

Virtual or remote appearances

KXUSAIRANAGREEMENT.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
KXUSAIRANAGREEMENT.rules_primary: If the United States has agreed to, signed, or accepted a new Iran-US nuclear deal before Aug 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXUSAIRANAGREEMENT.rules_secondary:
An agreement also made with other countries (i.e. multilaterally) is still encompassed if the United States participates. "A new Iran-US nuclear deal" means a formal written agreement signed by authorized representatives of both the United States and Iran that (1) imposes verifiable restrictions on Iran's nuclear program, including limits on uranium enrichment, centrifuge numbers, or nuclear facility operations, AND (2) provides for the lifting, suspension, or modification of at least one US economic sanction on Iran in exchange for Iran's nuclear commitments.

Clarification (04/19/26): The Agreement Long rulebook variable defines the nature of the qualifying instrument: it must be a formal written agreement signed by authorized representatives of both governments. It does not impose a precondition that the signing itself must occur before resolution. Because the Payout Criterion is satisfied if the United States has "agreed to, signed, or accepted" such an instrument, both governments publicly and officially agreeing to the terms of what will be a qualifying written agreement is sufficient to resolve the market to Yes, even if the formal signing has not yet taken place.

Clarification (06/02/26): A qualifying instrument must impose "verifiable restrictions on Iran's nuclear program." A restriction is "verifiable" only where it establishes a concrete, objectively ascertainable standard (a defined limit, prohibition, quantity, or monitoring provision) against which compliance could in principle be confirmed; a general expression of intent that fixes no such standard is not considered “verifiable” for the purposes of this event. Accordingly, a bare pledge not to develop or pursue nuclear weapons, unaccompanied by any concrete limit on Iran's nuclear materials, activities, or facilities, does not on its own satisfy criterion (1). Conversely, a commitment to completely 'stop' or ‘suspend’ a specific nuclear activity (such as uranium enrichment) establishes a concrete prohibition (an implicit limit of zero) and qualifies as a restriction, whereas a vague promise to 'reduce' activities without a defined metric or monitoring mechanism does not. The enumerated examples (limits on uranium enrichment, centrifuge numbers, or nuclear facility operations) are illustrative and not exhaustive: a formal, verifiable commitment to remove, transfer, or cap Iran's stock of enriched uranium, confirmable by the receiving state or an oversight body, is a restriction on Iran's nuclear program and satisfies criterion (1). In every case, criterion (2) must independently be met.

Clarification (06/17/26): To clarify, the U.S.–Iran memorandum of understanding reportedly now in effect does not satisfy criterion (1) of the definition of a "new Iran-US nuclear deal," and this market will therefore not resolve to Yes on the basis of that instrument at this time. The memorandum provides for the existing state of Iran's nuclear program to be maintained pending a subsequent agreement, and defers the disposition of Iran's stockpile of enriched uranium to a mechanism to be mutually agreed in that subsequent agreement. That it states a minimum methodology for that future mechanism — down-blending on site under IAEA supervision — constrains the form of a mechanism yet to be agreed, but specifies no quantity, enrichment level, or completion deadline for the down-blending. An instrument that provides for maintaining Iran's nuclear program at an unspecified status quo, or that defers its substantive nuclear commitments to a subsequent agreement, does not by itself establish the concrete, objectively ascertainable standard that a "verifiable" restriction requires.
KXUSAIRANAGREEMENT.subtitle: Before August

KXVOTEMILLSEXPEL.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
KXVOTEMILLSEXPEL.rules_primary: If the House has conducted any recorded vote on any resolution providing for the expulsion of Representative Cory Mills (R-FL) from the United States House of Representatives before Aug 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXVOTEMILLSEXPEL.rules_secondary:
This includes:
Roll call votes
Recorded votes
Yea-and-nay votes
Electronic votes (in the House)
Division/standing votes

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Voice votes where individual member positions are not recorded
Unanimous consent agreements without a recorded vote
Votes in committee, unless the bill/motion specifically refers to a committee vote
Procedural determinations by the presiding officer
Deemed passage without an actual vote

For clarity:
A vote on cloture regarding the bill/motion, including cloture on a motion to proceed to the bill/motion, DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion
A vote on the rule governing debate of the bill/motion DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion if the bill/motion specifically refers to that rule
A vote on a motion to proceed to the bill/motion DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion
A vote on final passage DOES satisfy the Payout Criterion
A vote on an amendment to the bill/motion does NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion unless the bill/motion specifically refers to that amendment
KXVOTEMILLSEXPEL.title: Will the House vote on any resolution providing for the expulsion of Representative Cory Mills (R-FL) from the United States House of Representatives?

KXWITKOFFRUSSIA.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the visit occurs.
KXWITKOFFRUSSIA.rules_primary: If Steve Witkoff has physically travelled to and been present within the geographic boundaries of Russia before Aug 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXWITKOFFRUSSIA.rules_secondary:
The following do NOT constitute a visit:

Flying over the area without landing
Layovers during which the person remains in an airplane
Virtual or remote appearances
Presence in international waters adjacent to the area
Presence solely within embassy or consulate grounds
Plans, announcements, or scheduling of future visits that do not occur during the applicable time period

For the avoidance of doubt, a visit occurs only when the person exits an aircraft, vehicle, vessel, or train within the area, or otherwise physically enters the area not aboard one. Remaining aboard, including during flyovers, drive-throughs, and non-exit refueling stops, does not constitute a visit. Exiting within the area constitutes a visit regardless of duration or method of exit.
